stage: CUBE-REV 0.10.5-R1.15 — Observation-operator Manuscript Bridge, Claim Compression & Cross-generation Argument Court

research_intent.primary: Compress the R1.7–R1.14 observation-operator history into a falsifiable methodological argument without converting diagnostic or development evidence into cognitive claims.
secondary: Construct an auditable claim-to-evidence ledger and manuscript readiness map.
Identify which cross-generation failures are scientifically informative rather than merely historical clutter.
Use writing/referee attack to expose missing literature, evidence, definitions, and fresh-validation obligations.
Decide whether a coherent paper-sized contribution exists now and, if so, what its narrowest defensible thesis is.
not_primary: write a polished final paper regardless of evidence gaps
claim that reconstruction annotations are latent cognitive states
reopen G4 measurement definitions because manuscript prose is inconvenient

paper_candidate.working_thesis: Behavioral reconstruction traces are not self-interpreting: inference about expert problem-solving depends on a sequence of observation operators whose invariance, null behavior, provenance, and authority must be separately validated. CUBE-REV demonstrates this by repeatedly rejecting plausible but non-identifying operators and converging on method-specific state ontologies.
paper_candidate.empirical_spine: Public WCA/reco.nz linked reconstruction evidence plus sealed R1.7–R1.14 engineering/measurement courts.
paper_candidate.paper_type: measurement/methodology paper with empirical case study; not a cognitive prevalence paper
paper_candidate.scope_guard: Roux G4 fresh authority remains DATA_WAIT and cannot be silently promoted by manuscript synthesis.

section_unit_policy.unit: small claim-bounded section with explicit evidence IDs and prohibited extrapolations
section_may_advance_only_if: counterevidence/failed predecessor is represented when material
wording does not exceed the strongest supporting seal

argument_court.reason: R1.8–R1.14 artifacts are serially dependent; many files within a generation are not independent replications.
argument_court.failure_policy: Return the gap to research or narrow the claim; do not polish around it.

freshness_and_wait.watch_policy: irregular check during substantive CUBE-REV turns after any required manuscript/scientific seals
